rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded/hatching blastocyst and acknowledges some ambiguity, but it overstates visibility of a distinct tightly packed ICM, cohesive AA TE, and a well-developed blastocoel from this image, where structures appear somewhat less crisp and more difficult to grade definitively.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, prior live birth, BMI, endometrium, sperm parameters, and smoking with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to morphology and patient factors; minor issues include somewhat confident quantitative adjustments and assumptions about euploidy/implantation inputs.

Core recommendations such as SET and smoking cessation are guideline-concordant, but some additions (routine progesterone monitoring, CoQ10/DHEA/GH suggestions, methylfolate/MTHFR comment) are more speculative or not standard guideline-based recommendations.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, counseling, and discussion of PGT-A; slightly reduced by inclusion of less evidence-based adjuncts.
